findings.note: Covers picks Swift for 3+ receptions (Kalshi 54%), citing 8 catches on 10 targets over two games and Monangai likely out, though its own model projects only about 2.8 receptions, right around the 2.5 line.
RotoWire says Swift had 4 catches on 5 targets in Week 6 but Roschon Johnson got more work as the game went on, and Swift's workload could drop if Kyle Monangai (toe) returns Thursday.
Covers expects Monangai to sit a third straight game, with Swift and Johnson splitting work again (58% vs. 40% of snaps in Week 6), and notes Johnson had more receiving yards on fewer targets.
